# Enforcement Proof — live demonstration (2026-10-04)

This file is itself the artifact of a **live end-to-end enforcement demonstration**
run against the org repositories. It was merged **through the normal pull-request
path** (branch → PR → required check → merge); no direct push was used.

## What was proven

| # | Action attempted | Target | Result | Server message |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `git push origin main` (direct commit) | `Medxpert-org/ai-passport-spec` | **REJECTED** | `GH013: Repository rule violations … - Changes must be made through a pull request.` |
| B | `git push --force origin main` | `Medxpert-org/ai-passport-spec` | **REJECTED** | same rule violation (`pull_request` / `non_fast_forward`) |
| C | `git push origin demo/enforcement-proof` (feature branch) | `Medxpert-org/ai-passport-spec` | **ALLOWED** | branch created, PR link offered |
| D | merge this file via PR | `Medxpert-org/.github` | **ALLOWED** | required check `validate-codeowners` ran and passed |

## Interpretation

- The ruleset (`default-branch-protection`, see `.github/rulesets/`) is **enforced on the
  server**, not merely declared: even the organization owner can no longer push directly
  to the default branch. Anti-footgun, **without** locking the owner out.
- Feature-branch pushes remain allowed, so the *only* sanctioned path to the default
  branch is a pull request — exactly the intended behaviour.
- `bypass_actors` = RepositoryRole `admin`, `bypass_mode = pull_request`: the owner may
  complete a PR alone (solo-safe) but **cannot skip the PR**.

## Reproduction

```bash
# A) expect rejection
git commit -m probe && git push origin main

# C) expect success
git switch -c demo/x && git push origin demo/x
gh pr create --fill && gh pr merge --squash
```

## Scope / limits (honest)

- Verified only on `Medxpert-org/ai-passport-spec` (push tests) and `Medxpert-org/.github`
  (PR path). The same ruleset is applied to **52** non-archived repositories; a per-repo
  push test was not run for every repository.
- `required_approving_review_count = 0` — a second human reviewer is **not** required yet;
  the "second pair of eyes" role is currently delegated to CI checks. A real second
  reviewer remains a known gap (org currently has a single admin).
- Branch-deletion and non-fast-forward are blocked by the same ruleset; only the
  pull-request requirement is exercised above.
